blocks.text: Origin / creation. Courts, continuity specialists, security reviewers, caregivers, and Reduction engineers formed audit bodies to examine every proposed stable core.
Identity / human status. Artificial institutional role.
Importance. They removed dormant commands, coercive loyalty, overwhelming autobiographical memory, hidden authorities, and mechanisms by which an ancestor could repossess a future body.
Decline or obsolescence. Once the final cores were certified and no complete institutions remained to create new ones, the role had no continuing operational purpose.
Final status / surviving function. Obsolete after certification. The Ancestral Claim Prohibition and identity boundaries remain embedded in Codex safeguards.
